subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: When a launched agent process ends, the system shall record one schema-valid record describing that process, or, where capture failed, one capture-failure entry naming it.
rationale: the process is the unit that emits a transcript, so it is the unit that can be recorded *(#D-3)*; the entry is the alternative terminal outcome UB-2 produces, so the two together are exhaustive
fit_criterion: across the checkpoint batch, every launched process in the authoritative launch record (FR-13) has exactly one of the two — a schema-valid record or a capture-failure entry — never both and never neither
